summary:
This brief reads the fact layer generated at 2026-11-10T20:37:03Z, which is 15:37 ET, 23 minutes before the 16:00 ET close, so it is an intraday snapshot and not a settled close: all 22 sector and theme rows sit on the 2026-11-10 US session, but the last print is not a closing price. Three vintages must be stated up front: all 11 China A-share last bars are dated 2026-11-09 because the 2026-11-10 bar never reached the provider series, so the China block is the previous settled session; rates and FX stop at 2026-11-06, credit and VIX are 2026-11-09, and CPI is still 2026-09; commodities are live quotes and crypto is a 24 hour window. Total risk 69.14 stays high_risk, with the regime at risk_off.

The 2026-11-10 tape is a broad but shallow decline: 21 of the 22 rows fell, with a mean of -1.1537 and a median of -0.7228, quantum computing -4.7325, the electric vehicle supply chain -2.3751, autonomous driving -2.1013 and robotics -2.0134 at the bottom, and digital advertising the only gainer at 0.3231. Of the 5 tracked US names 3 fell and 2 rose, a mean of -0.5509: NVDA fell 5.8785 to 168.166901 (RSI 23.7262, 22.8533 below its 50 day average, down 18.6381 over a week), MU fell 2.1715 to 717.22998 and TSLA fell 0.1455 to 377.5, while AVGO rose 3.9799 to 332.195007 and AMD rose 1.4609 to 516.01001. The China block, settled at 2026-11-09, had 4 of 11 names higher with a mean of -0.4856 and a median of -0.451, 001309.SZ strongest at 0.7636 and 300223.SZ weakest at 1.8726.

The total is up 0.56 from today's 12:36Z generation at 68.58, but that gain is assembled: cross-asset confirmation rose to 0.75 from 0.625, 6 of 8 legs on instead of 5, with SPY turning from up 2.3664 to down 0.4424 and switching spy_down on, worth 1.875 points; equity structure added 0.7 points as breadth fell to 0.3097 from 0.3548 and semiconductor relative strength widened to -16.7565 from -15.2623; trend added 0.115. Against them, volatility gave up 1.617 points and liquidity and credit gave up 0.512 points. Those 1.617 points are not today's tape: the VIX vintage caught up to the 2026-11-09 close of 19.92, the old 25.64 being 2026-11-06, and that alone took the dimension from 71.8 to 61.02. On the settled daily series, 69.14 is up 2.26 from 66.88 on 2026-11-09.

69.14 is still pinned by the level-based dimensions: liquidity and credit 74.21 (high-yield OAS 3.34 at the 83.67 percentile, investment grade 0.91, reverse repo 0.152 scoring 98.07 on risk, Fed balance sheet 6748145.0), macro 73.74 (real rate 2.63 at the 97.67 percentile, 10 year 4.86 at the 96.39 percentile, dollar index 121.8803) and cross-asset 75.0. Only the breadth limb holds risk_off: 0.3097 is 48 of 155 names, below the 0.35 gate, while VIX 19.92 is far below 28. The fact layer's regime_evidence prints the VIX limb as at or above 28, which contradicts 19.92; that is a known implementation defect and must not be read as a volatility state.

Events dominate the day: news reports put the CPI print at 0.4 percent month over month with core at 0.3, both above the 0.3 and 0.2 expected, while the model's own CPI series has not absorbed it and still stops at 2026-09; the 2 year yield jumped more than 20 basis points intraday, the 10 year auction cleared at 5.020 percent above the 5.010 percent when-issued level with a 5 percent coupon, the highest since 2006. FedWatch implies 4.075 against an effective rate of 3.88, pointing to a hike at the 2026-12-16 meeting; Waller backs 25 basis points then and 50 if needed, Logan says at least two more are required, Schmid says the current rate is not restraining the economy, and Bowman warns that an AI disappointment would hit equities. Nvidia governance risk kept building: the board hired Wachtell Lipton to lead an independent review, Schumer demanded Congress get answers on Trump's defence of Huang, and Nscale is weighing a listing delay. CLS and Wall Street CN items are RSSHub relays and are treated as second-hand aggregation only.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 75.0 is the largest single input, 6 of 8 legs triggered, worth 11.25 points after the 0.8 proxy discount, the first of all drivers. What fired: SPY down 0.4424, the dollar index at 121.8803, the real rate at 2.63, bitcoin down 1.46968 on 24 hours, small cap relative strength at -4.4783 and copper down 0.8533. What did not: high-yield OAS at 3.34 and gold down 1.7523, since gold_up requires a gain.

High-yield OAS at 3.34 contributes 6.6936 points at the 83.67 percentile and is the main source of the 74.21 liquidity and credit reading; investment grade at 0.91 sits at the 67.94 percentile. Credit eased rather than deteriorated today: high-yield narrowed from 3.42, investment grade from 0.93, and reverse repo fell to 0.152 from 0.252 with its risk score up to 98.07. The 4.0 credit gate is still 0.66 away.

VIX at 19.92 contributes 5.3648 points, but that is the 2026-11-09 close and not today's print; the entire 10.78 point drop in the volatility dimension from 71.8 to 61.02 is a vintage catch-up, with 25.64 being 2026-11-06 and realized volatility 22.0572 unchanged. In other words the dimension moved down today against the direction of the tape; it is a data catch-up, not a fall in risk.

Breadth at 0.3097 contributes 5.1149 points and is the only reason the regime stays risk_off: 48 of 155 names sit above their 200 day average, below the 0.35 gate and well under the 0.3548, or 55 names, of today's 12:36Z generation; new highs are 0.0255 at 4 names and new lows 0.051 at 8 names.

The real rate at 2.63 sits at the 97.67 percentile and contributes 4.8835 points, with the 10 year at 4.86 at the 96.39 percentile; both are 2026-11-06 readings that do not yet include today's post-CPI rate jump, so macro at 73.74 lags the inflation surprise and the real pressure only enters the model once FRED catches up.

supporting_signals.claim: All 22 sector and theme rows reproduce: the 16 equal-weight baskets chain to the published change and the 6 ETF proxies (SKYY, CIBR, IGV, SOXX, FDN, ESPO) match their own return, row by row to 4 decimals with 0 difference. The three mixed-session baskets memory, consumer_electronics and robotics dropped their Asian legs entirely at the last step because those legs have no 2026-11-10 bar, which is form two: memory keeps only 6 US names, consumer_electronics 8 and robotics 8, so all 22 rows are clean 2026-11-10 US session readings with no Asian-session contamination.

Semiconductors kept rotating rather than de-risking: AVGO rose 3.9799 and AMD 1.4609 while NVDA fell 5.8785; the equal-weight semis row fell only 0.6523, the SOXX proxy 0.3701 and SPY 0.4424, so the sector fell less than the stock. NVDA is down 18.6381 on the week, 22.8533 below its 50 day average with an RSI of 23.7262, the only deeply oversold reading among the 5.

Volatility and credit both eased: VIX fell to 19.92 from 25.64 across the 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-09 closes, high-yield OAS narrowed to 3.34 from 3.42 and investment grade to 0.91 from 0.93, and bitcoin held 73555 despite a 1.46968 decline. The fall came without a matching widening in volatility and spreads, which is the signature of an orderly pullback rather than a sell-off.

contradicting_signals.claim: Every US figure is cut at 15:37 ET and the last 23 minutes of the closing auction are not in the layer: the 22 row changes, SPY at 0.4424 and NVDA at 5.8785 can all flip sign on the settlement print, so this text can only be read as an intraday snapshot through 15:37 ET, not as the 2026-11-10 close.

The China block is the layer's largest defect: all 11 last bars stop at 2026-11-09 because today's 2026-11-10 bar never reached the provider series, so this run overwrote the correct 2026-11-10 closes published at 12:36Z, all 11 higher with a mean of 2.7562, with the 2026-11-09 session, 4 higher and a mean of -0.4856, flipping the sign of the same market. The figures can only be read as the previous settled session, never as today's China move.

The regime evidence strings cannot be quoted as written: the breadth limb at 0.3097 at or below 0.35 holds, but the VIX limb prints 19.9 at or above 28 when 19.92 is plainly below 28, so only one of the two limbs actually fired. The risk_off call holds, but the basis has to be breadth rather than that string.

what_changed_today: Total risk 69.14, up 2.26 from 66.88 on 2026-11-09 and up 0.56 from 68.58 in today's 12:36Z generation; both baselines point the same way but differ by a factor of 4, so any citation must name the one used.

Cross-asset confirmation rose to 0.75 from 0.625 as SPY turned from up 2.3664 to down 0.4424 and switched spy_down on, copper widened to 0.8533 from 0.4187 and gold to 1.7523 from 0.8069 without firing gold_up.

Breadth fell back to 0.3097 from 0.3548, from 55 to 48 of 155 names, dropping below 0.35 again; the regime therefore left risk_off for late_cycle at 12:36Z and returned to risk_off inside the same session. New highs fell to 0.0255 from 0.0446 and new lows rose to 0.051 from 0.0255.

The VIX vintage caught up to 19.92 for 2026-11-09 from 25.64 on 2026-11-06, taking the volatility dimension to 61.02 from 71.8, worth -1.617 points; that is a data catch-up, not a decline in today's volatility.

Credit and liquidity eased: high-yield OAS to 3.34 from 3.42, investment grade to 0.91 from 0.93 and reverse repo to 0.152 from 0.252, yet liquidity and credit fell to 74.21 from 76.77, still worth -0.512 points, because the reverse repo risk score rose to 98.07.

The tape fell broadly but modestly: 21 of 22 rows down with a mean of -1.1537, while the AI and memory complex sits in the bottom of its one year distribution, with ai_infrastructure, semis and data_centers all at the 2.2 percentile of 20 session returns, memory at 3.4 and semiconductor_equipment at 5.6, each on 232 observations.
The China block reverted from the 2026-11-10 close to the 2026-11-09 session, covered in contradicting signal 2, and is the only part of the layer whose sign flipped.
watch_next: The 16:00 ET close is the nearest data event: this layer is cut at 15:37 ET and the closing auction can change the sign of today's 22 rows, so only the next fact layer carries the 2026-11-10 settlement.

The 4.0 credit gate remains the cheapest falsifier: high-yield OAS at 3.34 is 0.66 away and a break would lift the 20 percent weighted liquidity and credit dimension, while genuine relief needs a move toward 3.0 before 74.21 eases.

The rate vintage stops at 2026-11-06, FX with it, and today's post-CPI jump is not in the model yet: the 2 year 4.51, the 10 year 4.86 and the real rate 2.63 are all stale, and macro at 73.74 will only reprice once FRED catches up; until then 69.14 understates this inflation surprise.

The calendar's nearest three nodes are CSCO on 2026-11-12, PPI on 2026-11-13 and NVDA on 2026-11-17; NVDA enters its report 22.8533 below its 50 day average with an RSI of 23.7262, the key test for this AI rotation.
Clearing 0.35 again requires 7 more of the 155 names above their 200 day average, 48 to 55; until then risk_off rests on the breadth limb alone and a single up day can flip it back.

Semiconductor relative strength at -16.7565 must be read on its 63 session window: if that relative weakness keeps widening, today's intra-sector rotation becomes a sector downgrade and the 0.6523 semis reading follows.

bull_case.title: Bull case: breadth recovers above 0.35 and the cross-asset legs unwind
points: Cross-asset confirmation falling back to 0.625 from 0.75 returns 1.875 points and to 0.5 more than that; it is the only driver that can reverse without new data.
With breadth back above 0.3548 and VIX near 19.92 neither risk_off limb holds, and the total can return to the 66 to 67 range.
Only credit narrowing from 3.34 toward 3.0 can move the 74.21 liquidity and credit reading, and together with breadth that is what takes 69.14 back toward 65.

base_case.title: Base case: 69.14 ranges between 68 and 71
points: Rates and FX stop at 2026-11-06 and CPI is 2026-09, so macro at 73.74 will not reprice soon and the level-based dimensions keep the total in the middle of high_risk.
Breadth oscillates around 0.3097 and the regime flips between risk_off and late_cycle, so a single session is likely to move the total by less than 2 points around 69.14.
3 of the 6 triggered cross-asset legs are level based, the dollar at 121.8803, the real rate at 2.63 and small caps at -4.4783 on a 63 session window, and they do not unwind quickly.

bear_case.title: Bear case: high-yield OAS above 4.0 plus VIX back above 28 pushes the total toward 75
points: If high-yield OAS rises through 4.0 from 3.34 the 83.67 percentile reading jumps a whole band, and the 20 percent weighted liquidity and credit dimension is the biggest lever.
VIX back above 28 would lift the 61.02 volatility dimension quickly and restore the second risk_off limb.
Breadth weakening toward 0.25 while semiconductor relative strength at -16.7565 widens further leaves room above the 68.72 equity structure reading, and the total can exceed 75.
